Real Estate Appointment Setter (Remote, Full Time, US Central Hours)

Watson Media House

Países permitidosMéxico, LATAM
Modalidad100% Remote (GMT-09:00 to GMT-03:00)
Idioma requeridoEnglish (Native or fully fluent)
Experiencia1+ year of outbound calling with US customers
Salario$8 to $12 USD/hour (~$155 to $233 MXN/hour) + $25-$100 commissions per client
HorarioFull-time, Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM US Central
Tipo de contrataciónFreelance / Full-time
Fecha de publicación2026-11-25 (Límite: 2026-12-25)

Descripción del puesto

Call US real estate agents in GoHighLevel to pitch listing photo, video, and drone services and build long-term repeat bookings with base hourly pay plus recurring commissions.

Funciones principales

  • Call real estate agents from provided lead lists in GoHighLevel (~120 dials and 20+ conversations/day).
  • Pitch the new agent offer and follow up until the first and subsequent shoots are booked.
  • Manage daily callbacks and no-answer lists proactively.
  • Log all calls in GoHighLevel the same day and submit a short end-of-day report.

Requisitos

  • 1+ year of outbound calling experience with US customers (real estate, mortgage, insurance, or solar is a plus).
  • Clear, confident native or fluent English and voice recording included in the application.
  • Experience with multi-week follow-ups and GoHighLevel (GHL) or CRM tools.
  • Available Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM US Central with reliable internet, quiet workspace, and headset.

Beneficios

  • $8 to $12 USD/hour base rate based on experience.
  • Tiered commissions per new client: $25 on 1st shoot, $100 on 2nd, $50 on 3rd, and $25 on 4th.
  • 2-week paid trial transitioning into a long-term remote role.
